findingNature.description: Required explicit discriminator (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §10a / FINDING_MODEL.md §4). Never inferred from attack_candidate_references cardinality.

trustBoundaryCategory.description: The 6 Trust Boundary categories already approved in THREAT_MODEL.md §4. Reused here, not redefined.

authorityImpactCategory.description: The 9 Agentic Action Attack Surface categories already approved in THREAT_MODEL.md §7. Reused here, not redefined.

businessImpactCategory.description: The 8 Canonical Business Impact Model categories already approved in THREAT_MODEL.md §9. Finding REFERENCES these; it does not copy or redefine them (FINDING_MODEL.md §6, ASSESSMENT_OUTPUT_MODEL.md §9).

qualitativeLevel.description: Controlled string, deliberately NOT a closed enum. FINDING_MODEL.md §5 treats HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW as a documented MVP candidate ('...等の少数段階を候補とする'), not yet a pinned Canonical enum by explicit Decision (LUVIRA-ASA-009 §24). Do not silently promote the candidate to a hard enum here.

findingLifecycleState.description: Mirrors FINDING_MODEL.md §8's stated sequence: Draft Finding -> Internal Review -> Confirmed Finding -> Severity Assignment -> Customer Output.

finding.description: Owned by exactly one Assessment; never reused across Assessments (existing Decision E). Contains no Framework/OWASP/NIST/MITRE identifiers (existing Decision K).

evidence_ids.description: A Finding with zero Evidence is prohibited (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §11, LUVIRA-ASA-009 §22).

attack_candidate_references.description: 0..N. STRUCTURAL_CAPABILITY findings may have zero. Whether ATTACK_SUCCESS findings must have >=1 is not conditionally enforced here — existing documents do not pin that invariant explicitly (LUVIRA-ASA-009 §23); left as an Open Question rather than invented.

likelihood.description: Optional (FINDING_MODEL.md §9b / existing Open Question). Never required, never folded into severity.

business_impact_references.description: Optional array (0..N). Not marked required/minItems here — existing documents establish the Reference relationship but do not explicitly pin a minimum count as a hard Decision.

then.description: Structural constraint for LUVIRA-ASA-008 §10b / LUVIRA-ASA-009 §26: confirmed_at present implies a human reviewer must be recorded. reviewer_actor_reference's own schema already constrains actor_kind to HUMAN.

A Finding at CONFIRMED or later lifecycle stage must record its confirmation (FINDING_MODEL.md §8: Confirmation is reproducibility/Evidence-quality confirmation, a prerequisite to Severity Assignment/Customer Output, and is a Human act per §10b).
Prevents semantic contradiction: a Finding not yet at the CONFIRMED stage must not carry a confirmation timestamp.
